transitions.compareText:
This revision against the 052 baseline
      Close
    
    
      Baseline: .dude/specs/052-dude-canvas-ui/design/fluent-desktop-workspace.html.
        Retained interactions: .dude/specs/057-dude-canvas-needs-you/design/needs-you-workspace.html.
        Neither file is modified by this mock.
      
        Preserved from 052
        
          Persistent command barBrand, one context control, one refresh action, sticky above the window.
          Left activity railSame 48px rail, same icon targets, same current-destination marker.
          Focal Next regionSame bordered focal surface with the brand edge, first thing under the identity strip.
          Lifecycle and progressSame stepper and segmented meter, with truthful unavailable treatment.
          Phases and Activity in the centreSame phase rows and event trail, in the work column, not the dock.
          Right properties and evidence dockSame docked aside, same property and source lists.
          Status barCoverage, connection and last complete read along the bottom edge.
          Fluid width and narrow collapseSame 720px and 1080px window thresholds; the shell fills the host.
        
      
      
        Moved from 057
        
          The single work finder057's search and Open/Closed/All now sit in the command bar; its results use the workspace instead of a permanent sidebar. It is one search, on screen only while no record is committed: once work is committed the record keeps the chrome in every view and Clear on that record returns to the same search.
          Context contentIntent, dispositions, source detail and evidence moved into Now and its dock. There is no separate Context destination.
          Response, capture and Review surfacesThe same six forms, New idea and the Review engine now render inside the shared shell.
        
      
      
        Adapted
        
          Committed work leads the chromeChanged for the 2026-09-14 command-bar review. The chosen record now sits first in the command bar with a brand edge, its number in the brand ramp and its full title at body size; Clear is demoted to quiet text. 052 carried one context control, and the reviewed revision put a wide search field in front of a small Selected chip.
          One work search, never twoChanged for the same review, then simplified when the added Switch work control was rejected as redundant, and changed again for the 2026-09-14 review that asked for a single main search: to switch work you clear the filters first. The committed record, not the current view, now decides what the one selector shows. While work is selected the search and Show selection are gone everywhere — Overview included — and Overview lists only that selected record, with counts and wording that say so instead of "Nothing is selected"; that row reopens the same Now. Clear is the one way back: it ends the selection, empties the search, shows All records, returns the list to the start and puts the caret in that same field, so an earlier query cannot trap the next choice. The empty search, All records and starting position are the definition owner's reading of "clear the filters", not a literal answer from the review. Clear ends the work filter only: no work is closed or cancelled, no request answered, no draft or saved local markup lost. Launch still opens Overview on Open, and ordinary navigation while nothing is committed keeps the search, Show selection and list position.
          Selected record as the object headerChanged for the same review. Number and name now lead Now at 24px with the record's state beside them and its Review design action attached, instead of a 16px line under a breadcrumb that repeated the same title. The breadcrumb keeps the number only.
          Rich numbered rowsEach row carries the zero-padded lifecycle number with name, status and progress, in ascending capture order. 052 listed one identifier per row; 057 sorted alphabetically.
          Next as body textThe full recorded instruction is readable body text under a short "Next step" heading, instead of 052's oversized headline.
          Real rail destinationsOverview, Now, Needs you and New idea all work. 052's five disabled "later cycle" buttons are gone.
          Focused ReviewReview is a child view entered from a current request, with secondary detail disclosed under a stage that pans inside itself.
          Narrow navigation and returnThe rail becomes labelled navigation, the dock becomes an in-flow disclosure, and an ordinary return keeps the selection, and the search, Show selection and position of an uncommitted finder.
          Prototype strip held away from the productChanged for the same review, which asked whether the explanation band was part of the product. The strip is now hatched, flagged and closed by a labelled edge; nothing it explains has been hidden.
        
      
      
        Deferred or omitted
        
          Inert future navigationWork, Artifacts, Memory and Team rail buttons are not drawn, because nothing stands behind them.
          Automatic Review opening (054)Review still requires a deliberate action on a current request.
          Annotation direct manipulation (059)The existing annotation grammar is shown unchanged; no new manipulation is proposed.
          Editing artifacts, arbitrary commands, execution controlsOut of scope for 062 and absent here.
          Omission is not cancellation: the broader 052 direction remains the product direction.
        
      
      
        Walkthrough this mock supports
        
          DiscoverSearch or scope in the command bar; every matching record is reachable by scroll and keyboard.
          SelectOne activation on a row opens that exact record in Now, where its number and name lead the work area; nothing is selected for you.
          SwitchSwitching work starts by clearing its filter. Overview keeps the record you are on and lists only that record until you clear, and Clear on the committed record is the single way back to the search: it ends the selection, empties the search, shows All records, returns the list to the start and focuses that same field. Neither closes, cancels or discards anything.
          ReorientNext step or the reason there is none, lifecycle, progress, phases, activity, and evidence in the dock.
          Answer or reviewOpen a current request from Now or Needs you, answer it, or enter Review for an eligible preview. Requests for other scopes stay listed and keep their own scope while work is selected.
          ReturnBack returns to where you came from with the selection, unsent input and Review work intact; an uncommitted finder also keeps its search, Show selection and list position. Only Clear resets the work lookup.

          Right properties and evidence dockSame docked aside, same property and source lists.
          Status barCoverage, connection and last complete read along the bottom edge.
          Fluid width and narrow collapseSame 720px and 1080px window thresholds; the shell fills the host.
        
      
      
        Moved from 057
        
          The single work finder057's search and Open/Closed/All now sit in the command bar; its results use the workspace instead of a permanent sidebar. It is one search, on screen only while no record is committed: once work is committed the record keeps the chrome in every view and Clear on that record returns to the same search.
          Context contentIntent, dispositions, source detail and evidence moved into Now and its dock. There is no separate Context destination.
          Response, capture and Review surfacesThe same six forms, New idea and the Review engine now render inside the shared shell.
        
      
      
        Adapted
        
          Committed work leads the chromeChanged for the 2026-09-14 command-bar review. The chosen record now sits first in the command bar with a brand edge, its number in the brand ramp and its full title at body size; Clear is demoted to quiet text. 052 carried one context control, and the reviewed revision put a wide search field in front of a small Selected chip.
          One work search, never twoChanged for the same review, then simplified when the added Switch work control was rejected as redundant, and changed again for the 2026-09-14 review that asked for a single main search: to switch work you clear the filters first. The committed record, not the current view, now decides what the one selector shows. While work is selected the search and Show selection are gone everywhere — Overview included — and Overview lists only that selected record, with counts and wording that say so instead of "Nothing is selected"; that row reopens the same Now. Clear is the one way back: it ends the selection, empties the search, shows All records, returns the list to the start and puts the caret in that same field, so an earlier query cannot trap the next choice. The empty search, All records and starting position are the definition owner's reading of "clear the filters", not a literal answer from the review. Clear ends the work filter only: no work is closed or cancelled, no request answered, no draft or saved local markup lost. Launch still opens Overview on Open, and ordinary navigation while nothing is committed keeps the search, Show selection and list position.
          Selected record as the object headerChanged for the same review. Number and name now lead Now at 24px with the record's state beside them and its Review design action attached, instead of a 16px line under a breadcrumb that repeated the same title. The breadcrumb keeps the number only.

          Next as body textThe full recorded instruction is readable body text under a short "Next step" heading, instead of 052's oversized headline.
          Real rail destinationsOverview, Now, Needs you and New idea all work. 052's five disabled "later cycle" buttons are gone.
          Focused ReviewReview is a child view entered from a current request, with secondary detail disclosed under a stage that pans inside itself.
          Narrow navigation and returnThe rail becomes labelled navigation, the dock becomes an in-flow disclosure, and an ordinary return keeps the selection, and the search, Show selection and position of an uncommitted finder.
          Prototype strip held away from the productChanged for the same review, which asked whether the explanation band was part of the product. The strip is now hatched, flagged and closed by a labelled edge; nothing it explains has been hidden.

          Inert future navigationWork, Artifacts, Memory and Team rail buttons are not drawn, because nothing stands behind them.
          Automatic Review opening (054)Review still requires a deliberate action on a current request.
          Annotation direct manipulation (059)The existing annotation grammar is shown unchanged; no new manipulation is proposed.
          Editing artifacts, arbitrary commands, execution controlsOut of scope for 062 and absent here.
          Omission is not cancellation: the broader 052 direction remains the product direction.

          DiscoverSearch or scope in the command bar; every matching record is reachable by scroll and keyboard.
          SelectOne activation on a row opens that exact record in Now, where its number and name lead the work area; nothing is selected for you.
          SwitchSwitching work starts by clearing its filter. Overview keeps the record you are on and lists only that record until you clear, and Clear on the committed record is the single way back to the search: it ends the selection, empties the search, shows All records, returns the list to the start and focuses that same field. Neither closes, cancels or discards anything.

          ReturnBack returns to where you came from with the selection, unsent input and Review work intact; an uncommitted finder also keeps its search, Show selection and list position. Only Clear resets the work lookup.

Overview keeps the record you are on and lists only that record until you clear, and Clear on the committed record is the single way back to the search: it ends the selection, empties the search, shows All records, returns the list to the start and focuses that same field.       Close
    
    
      Baseline: .dude/specs/052-dude-canvas-ui/design/fluent-desktop-workspace.html.
        Retained interactions: .dude/specs/057-dude-canvas-needs-you/design/needs-you-workspace.html.
        Neither file is modified by this mock.
      
        Preserved from 052
        
          Persistent command barBrand, one context control, one refresh action, sticky above the window.

          Lifecycle and progressSame stepper and segmented meter, with truthful unavailable treatment.

          Next as body textThe full recorded instruction is readable body text under a short "Next step" heading, instead of 052's oversized headline.

transitions.compareText:
This revision against the 052 baseline
      Close
    
    
      Baseline: .dude/specs/052-dude-canvas-ui/design/fluent-desktop-workspace.html.
        Retained interactions: .dude/specs/057-dude-canvas-needs-you/design/needs-you-workspace.html.
        Neither file is modified by this mock.
      
        Preserved from 052
        
          Persistent command barBrand, one context control, one refresh action, sticky above the window.
          Left activity railSame 48px rail, same icon targets, same current-destination marker.
          Focal Next regionSame bordered focal surface with the brand edge, first thing under the identity strip.
          Lifecycle and progressSame stepper and segmented meter, with truthful unavailable treatment.
          Phases and Activity in the centreSame phase rows and event trail, in the work column, not the dock.
          Right properties and evidence dockSame docked aside, same property and source lists.
          Status barCoverage, connection and last complete read along the bottom edge.
          Fluid width and narrow collapseSame 720px and 1080px window thresholds; the shell fills the host.
        
      
      
        Moved from 057
        
          The single work finder057's search and Open/Closed/All now sit in the command bar; its results use the workspace instead of a permanent sidebar. It is one search, on screen only while no record is committed: once work is committed the record keeps the chrome in every view and Clear on that record returns to the same search.
          Context contentIntent, dispositions, source detail and evidence moved into Now and its dock. There is no separate Context destination.
          Response, capture and Review surfacesThe same six forms, New idea and the Review engine now render inside the shared shell.
        
      
      
        Adapted
        
          Committed work leads the chromeChanged for the 2026-09-14 command-bar review. The chosen record now sits first in the command bar with a brand edge, its number in the brand ramp and its full title at body size; Clear is demoted to quiet text. 052 carried one context control, and the reviewed revision put a wide search field in front of a small Selected chip.
          One work search, never twoChanged for the same review, then simplified when the added Switch work control was rejected as redundant, and changed again for the 2026-09-14 review that asked for a single main search: to switch work you clear the filters first. The committed record, not the current view, now decides what the one selector shows. While work is selected the search and Show selection are gone everywhere — Overview included — and Overview lists only that selected record, with counts and wording that say so instead of "Nothing is selected"; that row reopens the same Now. Clear is the one way back: it ends the selection, empties the search, shows All records, returns the list to the start and puts the caret in that same field, so an earlier query cannot trap the next choice. The empty search, All records and starting position are the definition owner's reading of "clear the filters", not a literal answer from the review. Clear ends the work filter only: no work is closed or cancelled, no request answered, no draft or saved local markup lost. Launch still opens Overview on Open, and ordinary navigation while nothing is committed keeps the search, Show selection and list position.
          Selected record as the object headerChanged for the same review. Number and name now lead Now at 24px with the record's state beside them and its Review design action attached, instead of a 16px line under a breadcrumb that repeated the same title. The breadcrumb keeps the number only.
          Rich numbered rowsEach row carries the zero-padded lifecycle number with name, status and progress, in ascending capture order. 052 listed one identifier per row; 057 sorted alphabetically.
          Next as body textThe full recorded instruction is readable body text under a short "Next step" heading, instead of 052's oversized headline.
          Real rail destinationsOverview, Now, Needs you and New idea all work. 052's five disabled "later cycle" buttons are gone.
          Focused ReviewReview is a child view entered from a current request, with secondary detail disclosed under a stage that pans inside itself.
          Narrow navigation and returnThe rail becomes labelled navigation, the dock becomes an in-flow disclosure, and an ordinary return keeps the selection, and the search, Show selection and position of an uncommitted finder.
          Prototype strip held away from the productChanged for the same review, which asked whether the explanation band was part of the product. The strip is now hatched, flagged and closed by a labelled edge; nothing it explains has been hidden.
        
      
      
        Deferred or omitted
        
          Inert future navigationWork, Artifacts, Memory and Team rail buttons are not drawn, because nothing stands behind them.
          Automatic Review opening (054)Review still requires a deliberate action on a current request.
          Annotation direct manipulation (059)The existing annotation grammar is shown unchanged; no new manipulation is proposed.
          Editing artifacts, arbitrary commands, execution controlsOut of scope for 062 and absent here.
          Omission is not cancellation: the broader 052 direction remains the product direction.
        
      
      
        Walkthrough this mock supports
        
          DiscoverSearch or scope in the command bar; every matching record is reachable by scroll and keyboard.
          SelectOne activation on a row opens that exact record in Now, where its number and name lead the work area; nothing is selected for you.
          SwitchSwitching work starts by clearing its filter. Overview keeps the record you are on and lists only that record until you clear, and Clear on the committed record is the single way back to the search: it ends the selection, empties the search, shows All records, returns the list to the start and focuses that same field. Neither closes, cancels or discards anything.
          ReorientNext step or the reason there is none, lifecycle, progress, phases, activity, and evidence in the dock.
          Answer or reviewOpen a current request from Now or Needs you, answer it, or enter Review for an eligible preview. Requests for other scopes stay listed and keep their own scope while work is selected.
          ReturnBack returns to where you came from with the selection, unsent input and Review work intact; an uncommitted finder also keeps its search, Show selection and list position. Only Clear resets the work lookup.

transitions.compareText:
This revision against the 052 baseline
      Close
    
    
      Baseline: .dude/specs/052-dude-canvas-ui/design/fluent-desktop-workspace.html.
        Retained interactions: .dude/specs/057-dude-canvas-needs-you/design/needs-you-workspace.html.
        Neither file is modified by this mock.
      
        Preserved from 052
        
          Persistent command barBrand, one context control, one refresh action, sticky above the window.
          Left activity railSame 48px rail, same icon targets, same current-destination marker.
          Focal Next regionSame bordered focal surface with the brand edge, first thing under the identity strip.
          Lifecycle and progressSame stepper and segmented meter, with truthful unavailable treatment.
          Phases and Activity in the centreSame phase rows and event trail, in the work column, not the dock.
          Right properties and evidence dockSame docked aside, same property and source lists.
          Status barCoverage, connection and last complete read along the bottom edge.
          Fluid width and narrow collapseSame 720px and 1080px window thresholds; the shell fills the host.
        
      
      
        Moved from 057
        
          The single work finder057's search and Open/Closed/All now sit in the command bar; its results use the workspace instead of a permanent sidebar. It is one search, on screen only while no record is committed: once work is committed the record keeps the chrome in every view and Clear on that record returns to the same search.
          Context contentIntent, dispositions, source detail and evidence moved into Now and its dock. There is no separate Context destination.
          Response, capture and Review surfacesThe same six forms, New idea and the Review engine now render inside the shared shell.
        
      
      
        Adapted
        
          Committed work leads the chromeChanged for the 2026-09-14 command-bar review. The chosen record now sits first in the command bar with a brand edge, its number in the brand ramp and its full title at body size; Clear is demoted to quiet text. 052 carried one context control, and the reviewed revision put a wide search field in front of a small Selected chip.
          One work search, never twoChanged for the same review, then simplified when the added Switch work control was rejected as redundant, and changed again for the 2026-09-14 review that asked for a single main search: to switch work you clear the filters first. The committed record, not the current view, now decides what the one selector shows. While work is selected the search and Show selection are gone everywhere — Overview included — and Overview lists only that selected record, with counts and wording that say so instead of "Nothing is selected"; that row reopens the same Now. Clear is the one way back: it ends the selection, empties the search, shows All records, returns the list to the start and puts the caret in that same field, so an earlier query cannot trap the next choice. The empty search, All records and starting position are the definition owner's reading of "clear the filters", not a literal answer from the review. Clear ends the work filter only: no work is closed or cancelled, no request answered, no draft or saved local markup lost. Launch still opens Overview on Open, and ordinary navigation while nothing is committed keeps the search, Show selection and list position.
          Selected record as the object headerChanged for the same review. Number and name now lead Now at 24px with the record's state beside them and its Review design action attached, instead of a 16px line under a breadcrumb that repeated the same title. The breadcrumb keeps the number only.
          Rich numbered rowsEach row carries the zero-padded lifecycle number with name, status and progress, in ascending capture order. 052 listed one identifier per row; 057 sorted alphabetically.
          Next as body textThe full recorded instruction is readable body text under a short "Next step" heading, instead of 052's oversized headline.
          Real rail destinationsOverview, Now, Needs you and New idea all work. 052's five disabled "later cycle" buttons are gone.
          Focused ReviewReview is a child view entered from a current request, with secondary detail disclosed under a stage that pans inside itself.
          Narrow navigation and returnThe rail becomes labelled navigation, the dock becomes an in-flow disclosure, and an ordinary return keeps the selection, and the search, Show selection and position of an uncommitted finder.
          Prototype strip held away from the productChanged for the same review, which asked whether the explanation band was part of the product. The strip is now hatched, flagged and closed by a labelled edge; nothing it explains has been hidden.
        
      
      
        Deferred or omitted
        
          Inert future navigationWork, Artifacts, Memory and Team rail buttons are not drawn, because nothing stands behind them.
          Automatic Review opening (054)Review still requires a deliberate action on a current request.
          Annotation direct manipulation (059)The existing annotation grammar is shown unchanged; no new manipulation is proposed.
          Editing artifacts, arbitrary commands, execution controlsOut of scope for 062 and absent here.
          Omission is not cancellation: the broader 052 direction remains the product direction.
        
      
      
        Walkthrough this mock supports
        
          DiscoverSearch or scope in the command bar; every matching record is reachable by scroll and keyboard.
          SelectOne activation on a row opens that exact record in Now, where its number and name lead the work area; nothing is selected for you.
          SwitchSwitching work starts by clearing its filter. Overview keeps the record you are on and lists only that record until you clear, and Clear on the committed record is the single way back to the search: it ends the selection, empties the search, shows All records, returns the list to the start and focuses that same field. Neither closes, cancels or discards anything.
          ReorientNext step or the reason there is none, lifecycle, progress, phases, activity, and evidence in the dock.
          Answer or reviewOpen a current request from Now or Needs you, answer it, or enter Review for an eligible preview. Requests for other scopes stay listed and keep their own scope while work is selected.
          ReturnBack returns to where you came from with the selection, unsent input and Review work intact; an uncommitted finder also keeps its search, Show selection and list position. Only Clear resets the work lookup.

This revision against the 052 baseline
      Close
    
    
      Baseline: .dude/specs/052-dude-canvas-ui/design/fluent-desktop-workspace.html.
        Retained interactions: .dude/specs/057-dude-canvas-needs-you/design/needs-you-workspace.html.
        Neither file is modified by this mock.
      
        Preserved from 052
        
          Persistent command barBrand, one context control, one refresh action, sticky above the window.
          Left activity railSame 48px rail, same icon targets, same current-destination marker.
          Focal Next regionSame bordered focal surface with the brand edge, first thing under the identity strip.
          Lifecycle and progressSame stepper and segmented meter, with truthful unavailable treatment.
          Phases and Activity in the centreSame phase rows and event trail, in the work column, not the dock.
          Right properties and evidence dockSame docked aside, same property and source lists.
          Status barCoverage, connection and last complete read along the bottom edge.
          Fluid width and narrow collapseSame 720px and 1080px window thresholds; the shell fills the host.
        
      
      
        Moved from 057
        
          The single work finder057's search and Open/Closed/All now sit in the command bar; its results use the workspace instead of a permanent sidebar. It is one search, on screen only while no record is committed: once work is committed the record keeps the chrome in every view and Clear on that record returns to the same search.
          Context contentIntent, dispositions, source detail and evidence moved into Now and its dock. There is no separate Context destination.
          Response, capture and Review surfacesThe same six forms, New idea and the Review engine now render inside the shared shell.
        
      
      
        Adapted
        
          Committed work leads the chromeChanged for the 2026-09-14 command-bar review. The chosen record now sits first in the command bar with a brand edge, its number in the brand ramp and its full title at body size; Clear is demoted to quiet text. 052 carried one context control, and the reviewed revision put a wide search field in front of a small Selected chip.
          One work search, never twoChanged for the same review, then simplified when the added Switch work control was rejected as redundant, and changed again for the 2026-09-14 review that asked for a single main search: to switch work you clear the filters first. The committed record, not the current view, now decides what the one selector shows. While work is selected the search and Show selection are gone everywhere — Overview included — and Overview lists only that selected record, with counts and wording that say so instead of "Nothing is selected"; that row reopens the same Now. Clear is the one way back: it ends the selection, empties the search, shows All records, returns the list to the start and puts the caret in that same field, so an earlier query cannot trap the next choice. The empty search, All records and starting position are the definition owner's reading of "clear the filters", not a literal answer from the review. Clear ends the work filter only: no work is closed or cancelled, no request answered, no draft or saved local markup lost. Launch still opens Overview on Open, and ordinary navigation while nothing is committed keeps the search, Show selection and list position.
          Selected record as the object headerChanged for the same review. Number and name now lead Now at 24px with the record's state beside them and its Review design action attached, instead of a 16px line under a breadcrumb that repeated the same title. The breadcrumb keeps the number only.
          Rich numbered rowsEach row carries the zero-padded lifecycle number with name, status and progress, in ascending capture order. 052 listed one identifier per row; 057 sorted alphabetically.
          Next as body textThe full recorded instruction is readable body text under a short "Next step" heading, instead of 052's oversized headline.
          Real rail destinationsOverview, Now, Needs you and New idea all work. 052's five disabled "later cycle" buttons are gone.
          Focused ReviewReview is a child view entered from a current request, with secondary detail disclosed under a stage that pans inside itself.
          Narrow navigation and returnThe rail becomes labelled navigation, the dock becomes an in-flow disclosure, and an ordinary return keeps the selection, and the search, Show selection and position of an uncommitted finder.
          Prototype strip held away from the productChanged for the same review, which asked whether the explanation band was part of the product. The strip is now hatched, flagged and closed by a labelled edge; nothing it explains has been hidden.
        
      
      
        Deferred or omitted
        
          Inert future navigationWork, Artifacts, Memory and Team rail buttons are not drawn, because nothing stands behind them.
          Automatic Review opening (054)Review still requires a deliberate action on a current request.
          Annotation direct manipulation (059)The existing annotation grammar is shown unchanged; no new manipulation is proposed.
          Editing artifacts, arbitrary commands, execution controlsOut of scope for 062 and absent here.
          Omission is not cancellation: the broader 052 direction remains the product direction.
        
      
      
        Walkthrough this mock supports
        
          DiscoverSearch or scope in the command bar; every matching record is reachable by scroll and keyboard.
          SelectOne activation on a row opens that exact record in Now, where its number and name lead the work area; nothing is selected for you.
          SwitchSwitching work starts by clearing its filter. Overview keeps the record you are on and lists only that record until you clear, and Clear on the committed record is the single way back to the search: it ends the selection, empties the search, shows All records, returns the list to the start and focuses that same field. Neither closes, cancels or discards anything.
          ReorientNext step or the reason there is none, lifecycle, progress, phases, activity, and evidence in the dock.
          Answer or reviewOpen a current request from Now or Needs you, answer it, or enter Review for an eligible preview. Requests for other scopes stay listed and keep their own scope while work is selected.
          ReturnBack returns to where you came from with the selection, unsent input and Review work intact; an uncommitted finder also keeps its search, Show selection and list position. Only Clear resets the work lookup.

transitions.compareText:
This revision against the 052 baseline
      Close
    
    
      Baseline: .dude/specs/052-dude-canvas-ui/design/fluent-desktop-workspace.html.
        Retained interactions: .dude/specs/057-dude-canvas-needs-you/design/needs-you-workspace.html.
        Neither file is modified by this mock.
      
        Preserved from 052
        
          Persistent command barBrand, one context control, one refresh action, sticky above the window.
          Left activity railSame 48px rail, same icon targets, same current-destination marker.
          Focal Next regionSame bordered focal surface with the brand edge, first thing under the identity strip.
          Lifecycle and progressSame stepper and segmented meter, with truthful unavailable treatment.
          Phases and Activity in the centreSame phase rows and event trail, in the work column, not the dock.
          Right properties and evidence dockSame docked aside, same property and source lists.
          Status barCoverage, connection and last complete read along the bottom edge.
          Fluid width and narrow collapseSame 720px and 1080px window thresholds; the shell fills the host.
        
      
      
        Moved from 057
        
          The single work finder057's search and Open/Closed/All now sit in the command bar; its results use the workspace instead of a permanent sidebar. It is one search, on screen only while no record is committed: once work is committed the record keeps the chrome in every view and Clear on that record returns to the same search.
          Context contentIntent, dispositions, source detail and evidence moved into Now and its dock. There is no separate Context destination.
          Response, capture and Review surfacesThe same six forms, New idea and the Review engine now render inside the shared shell.
        
      
      
        Adapted
        
          Committed work leads the chromeChanged for the 2026-09-14 command-bar review. The chosen record now sits first in the command bar with a brand edge, its number in the brand ramp and its full title at body size; Clear is demoted to quiet text. 052 carried one context control, and the reviewed revision put a wide search field in front of a small Selected chip.
          One work search, never twoChanged for the same review, then simplified when the added Switch work control was rejected as redundant, and changed again for the 2026-09-14 review that asked for a single main search: to switch work you clear the filters first. The committed record, not the current view, now decides what the one selector shows. While work is selected the search and Show selection are gone everywhere — Overview included — and Overview lists only that selected record, with counts and wording that say so instead of "Nothing is selected"; that row reopens the same Now. Clear is the one way back: it ends the selection, empties the search, shows All records, returns the list to the start and puts the caret in that same field, so an earlier query cannot trap the next choice. The empty search, All records and starting position are the definition owner's reading of "clear the filters", not a literal answer from the review. Clear ends the work filter only: no work is closed or cancelled, no request answered, no draft or saved local markup lost. Launch still opens Overview on Open, and ordinary navigation while nothing is committed keeps the search, Show selection and list position.
          Selected record as the object headerChanged for the same review. Number and name now lead Now at 24px with the record's state beside them and its Review design action attached, instead of a 16px line under a breadcrumb that repeated the same title. The breadcrumb keeps the number only.
          Rich numbered rowsEach row carries the zero-padded lifecycle number with name, status and progress, in ascending capture order. 052 listed one identifier per row; 057 sorted alphabetically.
          Next as body textThe full recorded instruction is readable body text under a short "Next step" heading, instead of 052's oversized headline.
          Real rail destinationsOverview, Now, Needs you and New idea all work. 052's five disabled "later cycle" buttons are gone.
          Focused ReviewReview is a child view entered from a current request, with secondary detail disclosed under a stage that pans inside itself.
          Narrow navigation and returnThe rail becomes labelled navigation, the dock becomes an in-flow disclosure, and an ordinary return keeps the selection, and the search, Show selection and position of an uncommitted finder.
          Prototype strip held away from the productChanged for the same review, which asked whether the explanation band was part of the product. The strip is now hatched, flagged and closed by a labelled edge; nothing it explains has been hidden.
        
      
      
        Deferred or omitted
        
          Inert future navigationWork, Artifacts, Memory and Team rail buttons are not drawn, because nothing stands behind them.
          Automatic Review opening (054)Review still requires a deliberate action on a current request.
          Annotation direct manipulation (059)The existing annotation grammar is shown unchanged; no new manipulation is proposed.
          Editing artifacts, arbitrary commands, execution controlsOut of scope for 062 and absent here.
          Omission is not cancellation: the broader 052 direction remains the product direction.
        
      
      
        Walkthrough this mock supports
        
          DiscoverSearch or scope in the command bar; every matching record is reachable by scroll and keyboard.
          SelectOne activation on a row opens that exact record in Now, where its number and name lead the work area; nothing is selected for you.
          SwitchSwitching work starts by clearing its filter. Overview keeps the record you are on and lists only that record until you clear, and Clear on the committed record is the single way back to the search: it ends the selection, empties the search, shows All records, returns the list to the start and focuses that same field. Neither closes, cancels or discards anything.
          ReorientNext step or the reason there is none, lifecycle, progress, phases, activity, and evidence in the dock.
          Answer or reviewOpen a current request from Now or Needs you, answer it, or enter Review for an eligible preview. Requests for other scopes stay listed and keep their own scope while work is selected.
          ReturnBack returns to where you came from with the selection, unsent input and Review work intact; an uncommitted finder also keeps its search, Show selection and list position. Only Clear resets the work lookup.

transitions.compareText:
This revision against the 052 baseline
      Close
    
    
      Baseline: .dude/specs/052-dude-canvas-ui/design/fluent-desktop-workspace.html.
        Retained interactions: .dude/specs/057-dude-canvas-needs-you/design/needs-you-workspace.html.
        Neither file is modified by this mock.
      
        Preserved from 052
        
          Persistent command barBrand, one context control, one refresh action, sticky above the window.
          Left activity railSame 48px rail, same icon targets, same current-destination marker.
          Focal Next regionSame bordered focal surface with the brand edge, first thing under the identity strip.
          Lifecycle and progressSame stepper and segmented meter, with truthful unavailable treatment.
          Phases and Activity in the centreSame phase rows and event trail, in the work column, not the dock.
          Right properties and evidence dockSame docked aside, same property and source lists.
          Status barCoverage, connection and last complete read along the bottom edge.
          Fluid width and narrow collapseSame 720px and 1080px window thresholds; the shell fills the host.
        
      
      
        Moved from 057
        
          The single work finder057's search and Open/Closed/All now sit in the command bar; its results use the workspace instead of a permanent sidebar. It is one search, on screen only while no record is committed: once work is committed the record keeps the chrome in every view and Clear on that record returns to the same search.
          Context contentIntent, dispositions, source detail and evidence moved into Now and its dock. There is no separate Context destination.
          Response, capture and Review surfacesThe same six forms, New idea and the Review engine now render inside the shared shell.
        
      
      
        Adapted
        
          Committed work leads the chromeChanged for the 2026-09-14 command-bar review. The chosen record now sits first in the command bar with a brand edge, its number in the brand ramp and its full title at body size; Clear is demoted to quiet text. 052 carried one context control, and the reviewed revision put a wide search field in front of a small Selected chip.
          One work search, never twoChanged for the same review, then simplified when the added Switch work control was rejected as redundant, and changed again for the 2026-09-14 review that asked for a single main search: to switch work you clear the filters first. The committed record, not the current view, now decides what the one selector shows. While work is selected the search and Show selection are gone everywhere — Overview included — and Overview lists only that selected record, with counts and wording that say so instead of "Nothing is selected"; that row reopens the same Now. Clear is the one way back: it ends the selection, empties the search, shows All records, returns the list to the start and puts the caret in that same field, so an earlier query cannot trap the next choice. The empty search, All records and starting position are the definition owner's reading of "clear the filters", not a literal answer from the review. Clear ends the work filter only: no work is closed or cancelled, no request answered, no draft or saved local markup lost. Launch still opens Overview on Open, and ordinary navigation while nothing is committed keeps the search, Show selection and list position.
          Selected record as the object headerChanged for the same review. Number and name now lead Now at 24px with the record's state beside them and its Review design action attached, instead of a 16px line under a breadcrumb that repeated the same title. The breadcrumb keeps the number only.
          Rich numbered rowsEach row carries the zero-padded lifecycle number with name, status and progress, in ascending capture order. 052 listed one identifier per row; 057 sorted alphabetically.
          Next as body textThe full recorded instruction is readable body text under a short "Next step" heading, instead of 052's oversized headline.
          Real rail destinationsOverview, Now, Needs you and New idea all work. 052's five disabled "later cycle" buttons are gone.
          Focused ReviewReview is a child view entered from a current request, with secondary detail disclosed under a stage that pans inside itself.
          Narrow navigation and returnThe rail becomes labelled navigation, the dock becomes an in-flow disclosure, and an ordinary return keeps the selection, and the search, Show selection and position of an uncommitted finder.
          Prototype strip held away from the productChanged for the same review, which asked whether the explanation band was part of the product. The strip is now hatched, flagged and closed by a labelled edge; nothing it explains has been hidden.
        
      
      
        Deferred or omitted
        
          Inert future navigationWork, Artifacts, Memory and Team rail buttons are not drawn, because nothing stands behind them.
          Automatic Review opening (054)Review still requires a deliberate action on a current request.
          Annotation direct manipulation (059)The existing annotation grammar is shown unchanged; no new manipulation is proposed.
          Editing artifacts, arbitrary commands, execution controlsOut of scope for 062 and absent here.
          Omission is not cancellation: the broader 052 direction remains the product direction.
        
      
      
        Walkthrough this mock supports
        
          DiscoverSearch or scope in the command bar; every matching record is reachable by scroll and keyboard.
          SelectOne activation on a row opens that exact record in Now, where its number and name lead the work area; nothing is selected for you.
          SwitchSwitching work starts by clearing its filter. Overview keeps the record you are on and lists only that record until you clear, and Clear on the committed record is the single way back to the search: it ends the selection, empties the search, shows All records, returns the list to the start and focuses that same field. Neither closes, cancels or discards anything.
          ReorientNext step or the reason there is none, lifecycle, progress, phases, activity, and evidence in the dock.
          Answer or reviewOpen a current request from Now or Needs you, answer it, or enter Review for an eligible preview. Requests for other scopes stay listed and keep their own scope while work is selected.
          ReturnBack returns to where you came from with the selection, unsent input and Review work intact; an uncommitted finder also keeps its search, Show selection and list position. Only Clear resets the work lookup.

          Context contentIntent, dispositions, source detail and evidence moved into Now and its dock. There is no separate Context destination.

          Committed work leads the chromeChanged for the 2026-09-14 command-bar review. Baseline: .dude/specs/052-dude-canvas-ui/design/fluent-desktop-workspace.html. Retained interactions: .dude/specs/057-dude-canvas-needs-you/design/needs-you-workspace.html. Neither file is modified by this mock.
PRESERVED FROM 052
Persistent command bar
Brand, one context control, one refresh action, sticky above the window.
Left activity rail
Same 48px rail, same icon targets, same current-destination marker.
Focal Next region
Same bordered focal surface with the brand edge, first thing under the identity strip.
Lifecycle and progress
Same stepper and segmented meter, with truthful unavailable treatment.
Phases and Activity in the centre
Same phase rows and event trail, in the work column, not the dock.
Right properties and evidence dock
Same docked aside, same property and source lists.
Status bar
Coverage, connection and last complete read along the bottom edge.
Fluid width and narrow collapse
Same 720px and 1080px window thresholds; the shell fills the host.
MOVED FROM 057
The single work finder
057's search and Open/Closed/All now sit in the command bar; its results use the workspace instead of a permanent sidebar. It is one search, on screen only while no record is committed: once work is committed the record keeps the chrome in every view and Clear on that record returns to the same search.
Context content
Intent, dispositions, source detail and evidence moved into Now and its dock. There is no separate Context destination.
Response, capture and Review surfaces
The same six forms, New idea and the Review engine now render inside the shared shell.
ADAPTED
Committed work leads the chrome
Changed for the 2026-09-14 command-bar review. The chosen record now sits first in the command bar with a brand edge, its number in the brand ramp and its full title at body size; Clear is demoted to quiet text. 052 carried one context control, and the reviewed revision put a wide search field in front of a small Selected chip.
One work search, never two
Changed for the same review, then simplified when the added Switch work control was rejected as redundant, and changed again for the 2026-09-14 review that asked for a single main search: to switch work you clear the filters first. The committed record, not the current view, now decides what the one selector shows. While work is selected the search and Show selection are gone everywhere — Overview included — and Overview lists only that selected record, with counts and wording that say so instead of "Nothing is selected"; that row reopens the same Now. Clear is the one way back: it ends the selection, empties the search, shows All records, returns the list to the start and puts the caret in that same field, so an earlier query cannot trap the next choice. The empty search, All records and starting position are the definition owner's reading of "clear the filters", not a literal answer from the review. Clear ends the work filter only: no work is closed or cancelled, no request answered, no draft or saved local markup lost. Launch still opens Overview on Open, and ordinary navigation while nothing is committed keeps the search, Show selection and list position.
Selected record as the object header
Changed for the same review. Number and name now lead Now at 24px with the record's state beside them and its Review design action attached, instead of a 16px line under a breadcrumb that repeated the same title. The breadcrumb keeps the number only.
Rich numbered rows
Each row carries the zero-padded lifecycle number with name, status and progress, in ascending capture order. 052 listed one identifier per row; 057 sorted alphabetically.
Next as body text
The full recorded instruction is readable body text under a short "Next step" heading, instead of 052's oversized headline.
Real rail destinations
Overview, Now, Needs you and New idea all work. 052's five disabled "later cycle" buttons are gone.
Focused Review
Review is a child view entered from a current request, with secondary detail disclosed under a stage that pans inside itself.
Narrow navigation and return
The rail becomes labelled navigation, the dock becomes an in-flow disclosure, and an ordinary return keeps the selection, and the search, Show selection and position of an uncommitted finder.
Prototype strip held away from the product
Changed for the same review, which asked whether the explanation band was part of the product. The strip is now hatched, flagged and closed by a labelled edge; nothing it explains has been hidden.
DEFERRED OR OMITTED
Inert future navigation
Work, Artifacts, Memory and Team rail buttons are not drawn, because nothing stands behind them.
Automatic Review opening (054)
Review still requires a deliberate action on a current request.
Annotation direct manipulation (059)
The existing annotation grammar is shown unchanged; no new manipulation is proposed.
Editing artifacts, arbitrary commands, execution controls
Out of scope for 062 and absent here.
Omission is not cancellation: the broader 052 direction remains the product direction.
WALKTHROUGH THIS MOCK SUPPORTS
Discover
Search or scope in the command bar; every matching record is reachable by scroll and keyboard.
Select
One activation on a row opens that exact record in Now, where its number and name lead the work area; nothing is selected for you.
Switch
Switching work starts by clearing its filter. Overview keeps the record you are on and lists only that record until you clear, and Clear on the committed record is the single way back to the search: it ends the selection, empties the search, shows All records, returns the list to the start and focuses that same field. Neither closes, cancels or discards anything.
Reorient
Next step or the reason there is none, lifecycle, progress, phases, activity, and evidence in the dock.
Answer or review
Open a current request from Now or Needs you, answer it, or enter Review for an eligible preview. Requests for other scopes stay listed and keep their own scope while work is selected.
Return
Back returns to where you came from with the selection, unsent input and Review work intact; an uncommitted finder also keeps its search, Show selection and list position. Only Clear resets the work lookup.
